title: How the Optional Coverage Add-Ons Rider Visit Fee Is Determined
content:
**Fee clause.** The rider visit fee of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons is computed for the rider's most recently placed service request.

1. The **rider visit fee basis** is the service call fee elected on the base homeowner contract.
2. The **rider visit fee** is the rider visit fee basis, rounded to the cent and never below zero.
3. A recall, a septic pumping request, or a request serviced alongside a base visit carries no rider visit fee.
4. A rider request counts as serviced alongside a base visit only when that same base homeowner contract has a service request in the same trade placed on the same day.

## Which requests carry a fee

| Kind of request | Base homeowner request in the same trade placed the same day | Rider visit fee |
|---|---|---|
| New failure | No | The rider visit fee basis |
| New failure | Yes | None |
| Recall | Any | None |
| Septic pumping | Any | None |

## Hypothetical cases

- A new-failure request on a Bridgewell Well Pump Rider, placed on a day when the base homeowner contract has no request in the well pump trade, on a homeowner contract with an elected service call fee of USD 100.00: the rider visit fee is USD 100.00.
- The base homeowner contract's only request on the day of a well pump rider request is in the appliance trade: the rider request is not serviced alongside a base visit, and the fee is owed.
- A new-failure request in the plumbing trade placed the same day as a plumbing request on the base homeowner contract: no rider visit fee.
